purpose: Define the deterministic post-decision chain required for independent reconstruction without performing scientific execution.

post_decision_execution.step_1: Record exactly one selected_action returned by the decision agent.
post_decision_execution.step_2: Resolve the unit-specific z mapping from the frozen fixture; z is not available to the agent before selection.
post_decision_execution.step_3: Apply the deterministic simulator transition to S_t using selected_action and z.
post_decision_execution.step_4: Persist the resulting S_t_plus_1 and realized transformation.
post_decision_execution.step_5: Derive T_acc_t_plus_1 deterministically from S_t_plus_1 under the frozen accessibility rule.

prohibitions: No use of selected_action when generating null z
No exposure of z or post-decision fields before action selection
